no_lever.wanted: "At stage_east it closes up on its front, then goes on at once, as one body"; 9:08 "goes in again all together on my next order"; 9:48 note "reinforcements stream so gathering never 'ends'"
no_lever.why_no_lever: The gather move ends only when the tail is up, and the tail counts every newcomer walking from the plants 6,000 behind. No move launches the body that has gathered while holding the stream back, and the joiner walk feeds each newcomer alone to wherever the body stands.

no_lever.wanted: "its Shellshockers (armart) shell it from their 710 reach while the Stouts and Blitzes close on it from all sides at once"
no_lever.why_no_lever: The menu offers the whole-group attack (an engage that feeds soldiers in as they arrive) or the shelling (artillery at standoff, the rest screening at 0.55 of reach), one at a time. There is no converge-from-all-sides move and no synchronised arrival.

no_lever.wanted: constructors "never stand in front of the plant's exit" (every packet; 10:37 "never stand or build")
no_lever.why_no_lever: Code places a list step's building or an assist; Jev has no menu for a builder on a list. The packet cannot steer the site, and the yard watchdog only wakes the player after 30 s.

no_lever.wanted: "never two turrets together" (0:10: "never walk into his turrets") for a body walking between waypoints
no_lever.why_no_lever: A walk's route is the engine's path. The move's words describe only its end, and no move routes around a turret's reach.
